questions.question: The Indian National Congress was founded in which year?
questions.questionHtml: The Indian National Congress was founded in which year?
questions.solution: The Indian National Congress was founded in 1885 by A.O. Hume. The first session was held in Bombay from December 28-31, 1885.
questions.subject: general-awareness

questions.question: Who gave the slogan 'Do or Die' during the Quit India Movement?
questions.questionHtml: Who gave the slogan 'Do or Die' during the Quit India Movement?
questions.solution: Mahatma Gandhi gave the slogan 'Do or Die' during the Quit India Movement in 1942. The movement was launched on August 8, 1942.
questions.subject: general-awareness

questions.question: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place in which year?
questions.questionHtml: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place in which year?
questions.solution: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place on April 13, 1919, when British troops led by General Dyer fired on a peaceful gathering of unarmed Indians in Amritsar.
questions.subject: general-awareness

questions.question: Who was the first President of the Indian National Congress?
questions.questionHtml: Who was the first President of the Indian National Congress?
questions.solution: W.C. Bonnerjee was the first President of the Indian National Congress. He presided over the first session of the INC held in Bombay in 1885.
questions.subject: general-awareness

questions.question: The Dandi March was associated with which movement?
questions.questionHtml: The Dandi March was associated with which movement?
questions.solution: The Dandi March was associated with the Civil Disobedience Movement. Mahatma Gandhi led the 240-mile march to Dandi to protest against the British salt tax in 1930.
questions.subject: general-awareness
